shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: We deliver to every city in Pakistan through trusted courier partners.

sections.p: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours on working days. Major cities usually receive parcels in 2–3 working days, and other areas in 3–5 working days.
A flat delivery charge of Rs 250 applies to orders below Rs 10,000. Orders of Rs 10,000 or more ship free.
Pay in cash when your parcel arrives. Advance payment by bank transfer or mobile wallet is also available on request over WhatsApp.
After you place an order, our team confirms it on WhatsApp or by phone before dispatch. Please keep your phone reachable.

returns.title: Returns & Warranty
returns.intro: Shop with confidence. If something is not right, we will make it right.

sections.p: If a product arrives faulty or damaged, contact us within 7 days of delivery for a free replacement.
Products that carry an official brand warranty are covered for the period listed on the product page.
Send your order number, a short video of the issue and photos of the packaging to us on WhatsApp. We will guide you through the next steps.
Physical damage, water damage (unless the product is rated for it), and missing accessories or packaging are not covered.
We collect only what we need to deliver your order: your name, phone number, email, city and address.
Your details are used to confirm, dispatch and support your order. We never sell your information.
We share your delivery details only with our courier partner for the purpose of delivering your parcel.
For any privacy request, email info@gamingbynomi.store.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using this website and placing an order, you agree to these terms.

sections.p: All prices are in Pakistani Rupees and may change without notice. The price at the time of order confirmation applies.
Stock is limited. If an item becomes unavailable after you order, we will contact you with options or a full refund of any advance paid.
Images are for illustration. Colours and packaging may vary slightly from the photos.
You can cancel your order free of charge before it is dispatched by messaging us on WhatsApp.
